description: Customize the main 'Visitor Log' or 'Activity' grid view in Jolly Lobby Track. Configure the visible columns to display ONLY the following information in any order: 'First Name', 'Last Name', 'Company', and 'Time In' (or 'Sign In Time'). You must explicitly HIDE the 'Email' column if it is currently visible. Ensure the changes are applied to the active view.

metadata.context: Decluttering the security desk interface for privacy and efficiency.
